main.summary: Describes the logical notification scope a client follow session wants to observe.

property.name: ItemID
property.summary: Optional data item identifier used to scope notification delivery.

property.name: SessionID
property.summary: Optional local or remote transfer session identifier used to scope notification delivery.

property.name: SourceSessionID
property.summary: Optional source transfer session identifier used to scope follow notifications.

property.name: TransferFamily
property.summary: Optional transfer family hint used to filter notification matches.
